environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with custom OCI container image using a hardened base (distroless-nodejs). The container runtime is configured with a custom seccomp profile (applied via Lambda extension layer 'arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:999888777666:layer:seccomp-enforcer:3') that intercepts and blocks syscalls: connect(2) for AF_INET/AF_INET6 to non-RFC1918 destinations, sendto(2) for UDP to external resolvers, and clone(2) with CLONE_NEWNET flag. Additionally, the Lambda execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/OAuthLambdaBoundary) that denies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl and restricts the function to only be invocable through the associated API Gateway which has a request validator requiring redirect_uri to match a regex pattern ^https://(app|staging)\.example\.com/callback$ in the Method Request configuration with 'Validate query string parameters and headers' enabled.
